spec.description: Streamlit BLIP captioning app (CPU) + node_exporter — DA3408 A4

spec.title: Description

options.content:
1. Is the service healthy? 
2. How much work, how fast? 
3. What goes in and what fails? 
4. Who is using it? 
5. What does it cost the machine (node_exporter)?  
**Orange shaded bands** on every time chart = a *Bulk ZIP job* was running, so application spikes can be matched with CPU / memory spikes in 5. 
Hover one chart to see the same moment on all.

spec.title: Upload operations
spec.description: sum(upload_requests_total): 1 per single caption click + 1 per ZIP job.

spec.title: Active requests
spec.description: sum(active_requests): upload operations being processed right now.

spec.title: p95 inference (5 min)
spec.description: 95 % of images were captioned faster than this in the last 5 min (histogram_quantile over inference_duration_seconds_bucket).

spec.title: Since last caption
spec.description: time() − last_successful_inference_timestamp_seconds. Grows while the app is idle; growing during a bulk job means processing is stuck.

spec.title: Model load time
spec.description: model_load_duration_seconds gauge: how long the latest model load took.

spec.title: Model RAM footprint
spec.description: model_memory_bytes gauge: extra resident memory after loading the model.

spec.title: Throughput - images captioned per second, by mode
spec.description: rate(images_processed_total[1m]) split by mode. Bulk ZIP jobs appear as sustained plateaus, single uploads as short blips. Compare with CPU in section 5.

spec.title: Inference latency - p50 / p95 / p99 and mean per image
spec.description: Time inside model.generate() for one image. Percentiles from the inference_duration_seconds histogram; mean = rate(_sum) / rate(_count). A widening p99 − p50 gap means contention or unusual images.

spec.title: Where the time goes - mean seconds per image, by pipeline stage
spec.description: Stacked areas: mean preprocessing, waiting for the shared model, and inference time per image (each = rate(_sum)/rate(_count) over 5 min). Dotted grey line = mean total per-image time (image_processing_duration_seconds), not stacked; the small gap above the stack is token decoding.

spec.title: End-to-end upload time - p50 / p95 by mode (log scale)
spec.description: upload_processing_duration_seconds: one single-image request vs one whole ZIP job. Log scale because a ZIP job takes ~10–100× longer than one image.

spec.title: Bulk backlog - images queued vs job progress
spec.description: Left axis: images_queued (images still waiting in running ZIP jobs; falls to 0 as a job finishes). Right axis: bulk_job_progress_ratio of all running jobs combined (100 % when idle).

spec.title: Concurrency - active requests by mode and connected sessions
spec.description: active_requests gauge per mode (operations in flight) and active_sessions (browsers connected). More than one active request means users are queueing for the model.

spec.title: Per-image processing time - p50 / p95 by mode
spec.description: image_processing_duration_seconds: total time per image (preprocessing + model wait + inference + decoding, failed images included). Bulk being slower than single usually means users are competing for the model.

spec.title: Overheads - ZIP inspection and model-wait time, p95 (log scale)
spec.description: p95 of zip_extraction_duration_seconds (open ZIP + filter entries) and model_wait_duration_seconds (time an image waited for the shared model). Log scale: both are usually milliseconds but wait can reach seconds.

spec.title: Image funnel - accepted vs captioned vs failed, per minute
spec.description: increase(…[1m]) of images_uploaded_total, images_processed_total and images_failed_total. Accepted = captioned + failed (plus any left in an aborted job).

spec.title: Failed images by reason, per minute
spec.description: increase(images_failed_total[1m]) stacked by reason (corrupt_image, read_error, inference_error, …). The stage label of each reason: read → preprocessing → inference → decoding.

spec.title: App status
spec.description: UP when Prometheus can scrape the app's /metrics endpoint (up == 1).

spec.title: Upload volume - bytes received per minute, by mode
spec.description: increase(upload_size_bytes_sum[1m]) — the Summary's _sum: total size of uploaded images (single) and ZIP files (bulk) per minute.

spec.title: Failed upload operations - by mode and reason (since start)
spec.description: upload_errors_total: whole operations that failed (single: the image failed; bulk: bad_zip, no_images, all_images_failed).

spec.title: Image file size distribution - images per size range (since start)
spec.description: Non-cumulative buckets of the image_size_bytes histogram (bucket(le=b) − bucket(le=a)).

spec.title: Mean caption length
spec.description: Summary caption_length_words: _sum ÷ _count, per mode, since app start.

spec.title: Mean images per ZIP
spec.description: Summary bulk_job_size_images: _sum ÷ _count, since app start.

spec.title: Mean upload size
spec.description: Summary upload_size_bytes: _sum ÷ _count, per mode (one image vs one ZIP).

spec.title: Images in latest ZIP
spec.description: zip_images_discovered gauge: valid images found in the most recent ZIP job.

spec.title: Model status
spec.description: model_loaded gauge: 1 = BLIP is loaded and ready to caption.

spec.title: Upload operations by client - IP, session and browser
spec.description: upload_requests_total grouped by its client labels. One row per unique client IP + session + browser + mode.

spec.title: Images captioned per client IP (since start)
spec.description: images_processed_total grouped by the client_ip label.

spec.title: Upload operations per client IP, per minute
spec.description: increase(upload_requests_total[1m]) per client IP. Shades of one hue because the number of clients is not known in advance — hover for exact values.

spec.title: Browser sessions opened - by browser family (since start)
spec.description: sessions_started_total grouped by the browser label (parsed from the User-Agent).

spec.title: CPU utilisation vs captioning throughput - the key correlation
spec.description: Left axis: % of all CPU cores busy (node_exporter, solid vermillion) and the share used by the captioning app process alone (rate(process_cpu_seconds_total) ÷ cores, dashed purple). Right axis: images captioned per second (dotted blue). During a bulk ZIP job (orange band) all three rise together — the load comes from the model.

spec.title: CPU time by mode - % of all cores, stacked
spec.description: node_cpu_seconds_total by mode (idle excluded). Model inference shows up as 'user'; high 'iowait' would mean the disk is the bottleneck.

spec.title: Memory - machine RAM used vs captioning app RSS
spec.description: Machine RAM in use (MemTotal − MemAvailable), the app's resident memory (process_resident_memory_bytes, mostly the BLIP model) and total RAM as the ceiling. If 'used' nears 'total' during bulk jobs, give the VM more RAM.

spec.title: Disk I/O - bytes read and written per second
spec.description: rate(node_disk_read/written_bytes_total) across physical disks (loop/ram/cdrom devices excluded). Expect a read spike when the model is loaded from the Hugging Face cache.

spec.title: Network - bytes received and sent per second
spec.description: rate(node_network_receive/transmit_bytes_total) on real interfaces (loopback and container bridges excluded). Uploading a ZIP from the Mac host appears as a receive spike just before the bulk job.

spec.title: node_exporter status
spec.description: UP when system metrics are being scraped from node_exporter.

spec.title: Load average vs number of CPU cores
spec.description: Runnable processes averaged over 1 and 5 min. Above the core-count line (dotted grey) the CPU is saturated and work queues up.

spec.title: Root disk used - % of capacity
spec.description: Used space on the / filesystem (node_filesystem_*). Orange at 80 %, vermillion at 90 %.

spec.title: Firing alerts - rules.yml → Alertmanager → webhook
spec.description: ALERTS{alertstate="firing"}: alerts currently firing. Empty means all is well.

spec.title: App uptime
spec.description: Time since the app process started: time() − process_start_time_seconds (built-in metric).

spec.title: Firing alerts
spec.description: Prometheus alerts currently firing (details in the table at the bottom).

spec.title: Active browser sessions
spec.description: active_sessions gauge: Streamlit sessions connected right now.

spec.title: Images captioned
spec.description: sum(images_processed_total): all successful captions since app start.

spec.title: 1. Service health - is the app up and ready?
2. Throughput & latency - how much work, how fast?
3. Workload & outcomes - what goes in, what comes out, what fails?
4. Clients - who is using the app? (custom labels: client_ip, session_id, browser)
5. System resources - does the hardware follow the workload? (node_exporter + process metrics)
